declarations.confound: outguess rewrites the whole JPEG with its own encoder, so the stego half differs from the clean half in the writer as well as in the payload. Building at -p 95 matched the quality but not the encoder. A control arm carrying 0.03% of capacity through the same writer reproduces the effect at full size, and a re-encode by the original encoder carrying nothing reproduces none of it, so any separation measured on these arms is the writer rather than the hiding. Rebuild the control with generators/recompression_control.py.
